units.source_text: 此怨恨之词，亦请代为奏闻。”

en.t: Please also convey these words of resentment on my behalf to His Majesty."

units.source_text: 此次犒赏命妇，不宜用富有风趣之礼物。

en.t: For this reward to the court lady, it would not be fitting to use elegant or tasteful gifts.

units.source_text: 太君便将已故更衣的遗物衣衫一套、梳具数事，赠与命妇，藉留纪念。

en.t: The elder lady therefore gave the court lady a set of robes and several combing implements left by the late Intimate, so that she might keep them as mementos.

units.source_text: 这些东西仿佛是专为此用而遗留着的。

en.t: These things seemed almost to have been left behind for this very purpose.
